messages:
maria: FYI seeing sustained egress spikes and kernel drops on a bunch of eu-west shared-GPU nodes since ~10:12UTC. latency tails for small inference requests jumping to 2-3s. anyone picking this up?
ashok: yep, I started digging. NIC TX queue depth and drop counters spike in the telemetry. looks like a thundering-herd from one tenant hitting many pods in the shared slice.
kevin: confirmed from metrics: pps and bytes/sec for slice-shared-3 jumped 6x. CNI stats show tx_dropped increased. suspect noisy neighbor + egressthrottling needed.
maria: can we short-circuit to a mitigation: either pin heavy tenant to a dedicated pool or apply soft egress shaping on the slice?
lia: we have one spare dedicated slice in eu-west but it’s small (2 GPUs) — can we do partial drain + pin to avoid interfering with other services?
ashok: plan proposal: 1) apply temporary egress shaping on slice-shared-3 (limit burst to 200MB/s) 2) migrate the offending tenant’s active allocs to dedicated-scratch-02 with graceful handoff.
kevin: sounds good. ops-bot, can you push the shaping for slice-shared-3?
ops-bot: @kevin egress-shaper applied to slice-shared-3: burst=200MB/s, sustained=50MB/s. RuleID=egress-2026-3543.
lia: thanks. I'll start the migration for the top-5 allocations belonging to tenant:acme-ai now. moving to dedicated-scratch-02 with canary=2.
maria: migration command (what Lia used):
```bash
rbwctl migrate --tenant acme-ai --from slice-shared-3 --to dedicated-scratch-02 --concurrency 2 --grace-period 30s
```
kevin: putting a short QoS override on the dedicated slice so we don't impact backlog processing: set qos=best-effort->guaranteed for those allocs.
ashok: quick note: routing policy will prefer eu-west first; if we see >70% dedicated-scratch-02 utilization we'll reroute to eu-central fallback. keep an eye on cross-region cost.
maria: after shaping + 2 migrations latency tail dropped to ~120ms within 90s. drops decreased. good signal.
lia: leaving a follow-up ticket to evaluate if we should add automated detection: if slice egress p95 > 600ms && tx_drops > 1000 in 1m then auto-shape + notify + dry-migrate top N tenants.
kevin: please also add a cost tag for the migrations so billing knows about cross-region burst.
ops-bot: logged incident ticket: SRE-3543 (egress-thundering-herd). assigned: ashok, lia.
maria: 👍 will monitor for 15 more minutes then close. if anything bounces we fallback to preemptive pinning policy.
kevin: we should later discuss adding per-tenant egress budgets to prevent this causing noisy neighbor problems again. low-lift short-term fix was useful.
lia: agreed. I'll draft the proposal and drop in #eng-infra for routing policy changes.
ashok: thanks all, closing loop once metrics are stable.
